payload.title: The judgment sample item drops the adapter finding's confidence, actionability and review_reason, so the stratified_by_uncertainty ranking the cycle uses reads the default confidence 1.0 for every item and a finding that declares itself review_required at 0.55 ranks and costs a judge slot exactly like an actionable 0.9 one.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1940-1951 (_sample_item_from_finding keeps tool_id, run_id, rule, severity, path, message, evidence and the fingerprint; the adapter's confidence, actionability and review_reason are not copied)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1896 (the candidates the sampler ranks are these items, not the adapter findings)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:2066-2075 (_finding_uncertainty reads finding.get("confidence", 1.0), which is always the default for a sampler item, so the term can never move a rank)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:327-333 (declares confidence 0.55, actionability review_required and review_reason seed_or_bootstrap_context, or 0.9 and actionable)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:50-58 (AdapterFinding declares neither field, so no security-boundary row can ever carry the signal)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner of what a sampled finding is: the sample item is the one shape every downstream reader (ranking, tier-0, judge fan-out) sees, so a fact the producer declares and the ranking function reads must survive the item builder; a read that can only see its default is a dead term (PLAN-v2 section 1.2, one owner per fact).
payload.notes: Probe at ae2958653d: for the adapter finding {severity high, confidence 0.55, actionability review_required} _finding_uncertainty scores 0.57, but for the sampler item built from it from _sample_item_from_finding it scores 0.12, identical to the item built from the same finding at confidence 0.9. The ranking therefore cannot prefer or demote findings by the adapter's own confidence, and actionability and review_reason are read by no module of the funnel (tier0, judgment_funnel, finding_promotion, feedback_store, judge_fanout), so a self-declared review_required finding spends one of sample_size_per_tool slots like an actionable one. security-boundary rows can never carry the signal at all because its finding type has no such fields. Close condition: Carry confidence, actionability and review_reason through _sample_item_from_finding and decide in the one ranking function what a review_required or low-confidence finding costs, with a test that two items differing only in confidence or actionability rank differently; declare the two fields once for every adapter finding type (or state per rule that none exists). Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
